native_ui_checks: Largest accessibility text: accounts, rings, display controls, activation help, chart readouts and notifications
Existing Claude identity is named, reconnect preserves the account and opens its detail page
Choosing another Claude identity returns to new-account setup
Perplexity email expands a real iOS text replacement through onscreen keyboard taps
Compact display configuration and removal of redundant copy
Continuous chart readout and account selection
Four rings fit full percentages and formatted credit balances
Per-account activation preferences persist and Claude permission remains explicit
Manual and automatic activation prevent repeated requests after relaunch
limits: The plain keyboard control is diagnostic; the regression assertion verifies expansion in the app email field.
Claude uses a provider-owned system authentication browser; keyboard text replacement in its email field was not independently reproduced.
Provider request adapters are unchanged. No unused live weekly window was available; the activation countdown check remains pending at the next unused week.
Accessibility verification used simulator navigation, control actions and screenshot inspection; no claim is made that every provider-owned sign-in screen was audited.
Physical-device background refresh cadence was not measured.
